name: @thirdlight/three-adapter
description: Thirdlight M1 three.js scene adapter (docs/contracts/runtime.md §6/§8/§9 + planning packet 08): owns ALL Object3D/material/renderer lifetimes for the M1 scene graph (box primitives, simple Lambert material, one perspective camera, lights), transform synchronization from the runtime's interpolated state to the scene graph, one WebGL renderer path (WebGL 2 first, three@0.186.0 pinned), renderFrame/captureScreenshot(maxWidth)/diagnostics/dispose per the dependencies.md §3 surface row, and the adapter diagnostics block (the selected renderBackend is reported; there is never a second renderer path). Node-side dependencies (dependencies.md §4.1): @thirdlight/runtime, three (+ dev @types/three). The runtime core remains three-free.
